name: 10473 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10473 (Bronx) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10473 (Bronx) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10473 (Bronx) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
